text: Which of the following graphs correctly represents the variation of the magnitude of the magnetic field outside a straight infinite current carrying wire of radius ‘a’, as a function of distance ‘r’ from the centre of the wire ?

options.label: A
options.text: A straight line of negative slope, starting at a positive value of \(\mathrm{B}\) above \(r = a\) (marked by a dashed ordinate) and falling to meet the \(r\)-axis.

options.label: B
options.text: A straight line of negative slope, starting at a positive value of \(\mathrm{B}\) on the \(\mathrm{B}\)-axis at \(r = 0\) and falling to meet the \(r\)-axis.

options.label: C
options.text: A curve starting at a high value of \(\mathrm{B}\) above \(r = a\) (marked by a dashed ordinate), falling steeply and then flattening as \(r\) increases, without meeting the \(r\)-axis.

options.label: D
options.text: A curve starting at a high value of \(\mathrm{B}\) on the \(\mathrm{B}\)-axis at \(r = 0\), falling steeply and then flattening as \(r\) increases, without meeting the \(r\)-axis.
